links.outcome: Reading level of LLM patient-information responses (Coleman-Liau Index)
links.effect: Grok had the highest Coleman-Liau Index value (14.68); all models produced texts requiring a university-level reading ability.
links.quote: In the readability analysis, Grok had the highest Coleman-Liau Index value (Coleman-Liau Index=14.68), and all models produced texts requiring a university-level reading ability.

links.outcome: Understandability, actionability, and readability of LLM patient education responses
links.effect: No significant differences among models on PEMAT-U or PEMAT-A (p>0.05); all models good quality but difficult to read at university level; CLI up to 14.68.
links.quote: Although the Gemini model achieved higher overall quality scores, all artificial intelligence-based large language models provided good-quality but difficult-to-read information.

screen.reason: Evaluates commercial LLMs answering patient FAQs regarding cryptorchidism without testing a specific deployment safeguard or intervention.
